
---
title: "Local Search for GFlowNets"
---

## Project Overview

This project investigates the integration of local search
methods into the GFlowNet library.

The goal is to improve the discovery of high-reward
samples while maintaining reusable implementations.

## Motivation

GFlowNets learn to sample objects with probabilities
proportional to their rewards.

Local search can help explore promising regions of
the state space by refining previously sampled objects.

## Research Questions

1. How can local search be integrated into the
   existing GFlowNet library architecture?

2. Which components should be reusable across
   different environments?

3. How does local search affect reward discovery
   and sample diversity?

4. How does it affect the learned sampling
   distribution?
